main_subject.description: The same adult woman with a high ponytail, fresh natural makeup, and composed street-style energy across four frames.
main_subject.wardrobe: An oversized plain black hoodie, relaxed charcoal cargo trousers, high socks, plain chunky sneakers, and an unbranded cross-body bag.
main_subject.continuity: Keep adult identity, covered wardrobe, and overcast city setting consistent in the entire collage.

grid_sequence: Full-body walk across an unmarked crosswalk.
Side-profile seated safely on broad concrete steps, chin resting on hands.
Back-view full body facing an abstract blank billboard.
Medium shot leaning casually against a graffiti-free brick wall.
composition_elements.setting: Muted city street and alley textures, blank street signs, neutral brick, and soft urban depth.
composition_elements.layout: Four equal panels with narrow neutral gutters and no outer text border.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Cool overcast sky light, even and soft.

technical_specs.rendering: Crisp subject, realistic hands, natural skin, mild texture, no brand placement.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical 2 by 2 lifestyle collage of the same adult woman with a high ponytail, fresh natural makeup, oversized plain black hoodie, relaxed charcoal cargo trousers, high socks, plain chunky sneakers, and an unbranded cross-body bag. Show her walking over an unmarked crosswalk; sitting safely on broad concrete steps with chin on hands; seen from behind facing an abstract blank billboard; and leaning against a graffiti-free brick wall. Use a cool overcast urban street setting with blank signs and neutral brick. Make four equal panels with narrow neutral gutters, crisp digital 35mm-equivalent street photography, natural skin, realistic hands, and no brand placement. No logos, billboards, readable signs, text, watermarks, or sexualized styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, biker shorts, logo, branded hoodie, readable text, billboard copy, graffiti text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, AI artifacts
